name: Multiversal Battlegrounds
desc:
Learn to fight & survive.

⚠️ WARNING : This game contains blood, gore & scary elements.

If you don't know how to play a battlegrounds game, here are the controls.

M1/Button B/ Circle - Light Attack

Q - Dash, Q (While Ragdoll) - Evasive

1,2,3,4/LB,LT,RT,RB/ L1,L2,R2,R1 - Skills

Use combination of Light Attacks & Skills to perform combos.


VR is not supported

Console is currently in development.
